=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4792-5640 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The alert step's `if:` at line 5450 accepts `|| steps.single_issue_security_pass.outputs.exhausted == 'true'`, and so does the rb_judge `if:` at line 4526. The comment step (`id: rb_blocked_comment`) at line 4792 requires `steps.retrigger_guard.outputs.max_iterations_reached == 'true'` only. So when a judge crashes on the security-exhaustion-only path, no `rb-judge-crash:v1` marker is posted, `RB_BLOCKED_REPEAT` (line 5463) stays empty, and the crash block at 5616-5640 always logs `repeat=false` and sends CRITICAL.
  WHY: Every redispatch on the same head pages again: the stall-ladder `force_rb_judge` runs every 120 minutes, and each further security-exhausted run also pages. This breaks G3 ("a second judge-crash outcome for the same PR head sends no alert"). Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; google_gemini stated no severity. There are two proposed fixes. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 suggests passing `max_iterations_reached` into the alert step and skipping the override or logging `repeat=unchecked`, and says not to widen the comment step's `if:` because of G4. minimax_minimax-m3 suggests adding `single_issue_security_pass.outputs.exhausted` to the comment step's `if:`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5564-5645 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `if [ -n "${JUDGE_CRASH_REASON}" ]` crash block (5629-5639) replaces MSG but keeps the `JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL` set by the earlier `case "${JUDGE_SKIP_REASON}"`, for example DEBUG at 5574-5605. A judge that writes `judge_skip_reason=merge_conflict`/`mergeability_pending`/`blocking_check_runs`/`check_runs_query_failed` (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 3182, 3185, 3243, 3246) and then crashes therefore sends the crash alert at DEBUG via `tg_send_tracked` (line 5645).
  WHY: Under the default ALERT_MSG_LEVEL=WARNING the crash never pages anyone, while the `reason=judge_crashed` marker is still posted, so later redispatches are suppressed as repeats. This contradicts "The first judge-crash alert for a PR head is CRITICAL" and the agents.d contract `level=SUPPRESSED|CRITICAL`. Fix: set `JUDGE_ALERT_LEVEL="CRITICAL"` as the first line inside the crash block. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated NIT, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh:129-147 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The crash dedupe path makes three REST reads per crash run: GET /user via `_tg_tracking_author_login` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:324-327), then GET issue and GET newest comments page via `_tg_newest_comments_json` (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:437-447). The linked issue's API audit specified a single extra comment-page read.
  WHY: The identity cache does not survive across step shells, so a broad provider outage or systemic crash costs about 3x the planned API budget. It is still fail-open, so the cost is API budget only. Three reviewers rated NIT; google_gemini stated no severity. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not raise it, because the issue explicitly asked to reuse `_tg_newest_comments_json` and the changelog states "up to 3".

  WHY: This violates CLAUDE.md §19/§21: merging would auto-close the tracking issue and break the orchestrator's state machine, and the lint gate fails. google_gemini stated no severity; critical matches the BLOCKER rating that minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave the related task gap. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 calls this a false positive: the lines are fixture output from `tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` (ci.yml:813), and the PR body says "Closes .../issues/9249".

No `rb-judge-crash:v1` marker is posted and `rb_judge_crash_repeat` is never written. With RB_BLOCKED_REPEAT empty, the crash classification always takes `repeat=false` and sends CRITICAL.

Do not widen the comment step's `if:` (G4).
